title: Critical! spell catalogue, format 1
description: Shape of the spell catalogue artifact (ADR 0021). Shape only: the schema carries no book text.

format.description: Artifact format. An importer accepts exactly the formats it knows and refuses the rest.

version.description: Content version, UTC build date YYYY-MM-DD with an optional .N suffix for several builds on a day. Compared for equality only, never ordered.

localized.description: English is required; French is optional and the app falls back to English when it is absent. An absent language is omitted, never an empty string.

description.description: Paragraphs separated by one blank line (\n\n); no hard line wraps inside a paragraph; no leading or trailing whitespace.

id.description: Stable key, never changes once published (spellbook, spell effects and slots reference it). Derived from the English name by the key rule of ADR 0021 step 3.

school.description: Raw school text as the book prints it; may hold several, e.g. "Alteration, Evocation".

sphere.description: Priest spells only (raw text, may hold several spheres). Omitted for Wizard spells.

source.description: Book the English text comes from, a short code such as PHB or TOM.
